query: I have a 49‑year‑old female inpatient. Among female inpatients aged 44–54 with intracranial hemorrhage, what are median (IQR) risk score and 90‑day mortality? Compare major complication rate and median survivor LOS to female inpatients 44–54, and give matched risk percentile.
final_sql: SELECT f49.subject_id AS risk_score, f49.subject_id AS survivor_los, COUNT(DISTINCT mc.hadm_id)::FLOAT / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT dc.hadm_id), 0) AS major_complication_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT s.hadm_id)::FLOAT / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT hc.hadm_id), 0) AS survival_rate, percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY f49.subject_id) AS percentile_rank FROM f49 JOIN hc ON f49.subject_id = hc.subject_id JOIN dc ON f49.subject_id = dc.subject_id JOIN ic ON f49.subject_id = ic.subject_id JOIN mc ON f49.subject_id = mc.subject_id JOIN s ON f49.subject_id = s.subject_id GROUP BY f49.subject_id ORDER BY f49.subject_id NULLS LAST;
